crossRefs.note: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be…
Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love…
to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like…
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
translations.bsb: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
translations.kjv: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
translations.asv: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!
